pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.g3 e5 7.Nde2 Be7 8.Bg2 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 3 had a3 against ...b4 in a way the parser read as a Black move; plan 4 called d5 a dark square. Rewrote plans 3 and 4. Plan 1 (Nde2 to g3, where White's own pawn stands) was rewritten twice and rejected twice (the second time because the e4-pawn blocks the g2-bishop); old text kept with British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.g3 e5 7.Nde2 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted the f6-knight via e8-c7 and had a ...b5-b4 route; plan 4 aimed for a queenside passed pawn. Rewrote plans 2 and 4 (reviewer caught that a d7-knight does not cover b5 or d5).

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Najdorf Variation, Opocensky Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Rxc3 with the bishop on c8; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Reworded both.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Najdorf Variation, Opocensky Variation, Traditional Line
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the b3-knight via c1-d3 or a1-c2; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both (reviewer caught that a b3-knight does not support Nd5).

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be2 e5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...Nbd7-b6 route and called ...b5-b4 a minority attack; plan 1 had f3 and a g4-g5 storm in the Be2 line. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plans 3 and 4.

pages.notes: Plan 1 named White's exd5 recapture in a Black-to-move position the parser could not follow; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote both around the e-pawn recapture, c4-c5 and ...f5.
